title: User ID
description: Authenticated user identity captured when the case is created. Recorded automatically; there is no form for this element.

user_id.description: Supabase auth user id of the case creator

title: Project Information
description: Core project details supplied by the applicant. form_data is the JSON Schema the step 2 form renders.

description.title: Description
description.description: Summary of the project’s goals and scope.

sector.title: Sector
sector.description: High-level project category (e.g., energy, transportation, land management).

lead_agency.title: Lead Agency
lead_agency.description: Federal agency that supervises preparation of the environmental documents for the project.

location_lat.title: Location Latitude
location_lat.description: Center/centroid of project (shortcut for plotting on a map - should attach GIS data object as well)

location_lon.title: Location Longitude
location_lon.description: Center/centroid of project (shortcut for plotting on a map - should attach GIS data object as well)

location_object.title: Location Object
location_object.description: Container for more advanced location object if applicable or if this improves performance (should not replace gis data entity relationship)

type.title: Type
type.description: Classification, a sub-type of sector (pipeline, highway, habitat restoration).

funding.title: Funding
funding.description: Link to federal, state, local or other funding by reference (e.g., grant program, loan guarantee, appropriated funds)

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Environmental review initiation date (aggregated from process status)

current_status.title: Current Status
current_status.description: Current phase (pre-application, underway, paused, completed) of the NEPA, permitting, or other authorization process (aggregated from process status).

sponsor.title: Sponsor
sponsor.description: Name of responsible entity, organization, or person.

sponsor_contact.title: Sponsor Contact
sponsor_contact.description: Name of responsible entity, organization, or person (contact information json object)

parent_project_id.title: Parent Project ID
parent_project_id.description: If nesting projects, reference to the parent project's ID.

location_text.title: Location Text
location_text.description: Text field to specify location, eg. address.

other.title: Other
other.description: This jsonb field should be used for additional data structures as needed.

data_record_version.title: Data Record Version
data_record_version.description: This is the version of this data record.

data_source_agency.title: Data Source Agency
data_source_agency.description: This is the agency from which this data record was sent or retrieved or in which it is stored, which may be different than the record owner.

data_source_system.title: Data Source System
data_source_system.description: This is the system from which this data record was sent or retrieved or in which it is stored.

last_updated.title: Last Updated
last_updated.description: This is the last update of the data record in the system.

record_owner_agency.title: Record Owner Agency
record_owner_agency.description: This is the owner of the original data, generally the authoritative data source.

retrieved_timestamp.title: Retrieved Timestamp
retrieved_timestamp.description: This is the timestamp of a retrieval or transmission (e.g. responding to an API call).

title: Analysis Document
description: Draft project analysis prepared by the applicant. Submitted as a document record rather than a form.

title: Environmental Review
description: Environmental analysis prepared by an agency analyst. The analyst must not be the case creator.

title: Approval
description: Final approval decision. The approver must be neither the case creator nor the analyst who prepared the review.

expected_evaluation_data.title: ApprovalDecision

approved_at.title: Approved At
approved_at.description: Set when the decision is approval.

approver_id.title: Approver ID
approver_id.description: Auth user id of the approver.

decision_at.title: Decision At
decision_at.description: Set when changes are requested instead.

expected_evaluation_data.description: Written on approval; result carries "approved" or "changes_requested" and result_notes the comments.
